svg.text: Icon Style choice: Quiet, Living and Glow
Solid shape: rest pose. Dashed outline: extreme pose of the hero motion. Glow uses no filters (two stroke halos per accent piece and one gradient bloom).
hero only, one axis, max 0.3 unit
Icons: MDI by Pictogrammers (Apache-2.0) and Magic Card rigs cut from MDI. Rules: assets/brand/icon-library/p4-spec.json, section styles.
